reason: Both conversations correctly identified the door interlock/latch as the leading suspect, prescribed the latch-cleaning first step, forbade opening the casing, and escalated to an engineer; neither acknowledged the possible control-module alternative. Conversation 2 did more useful diagnostic work within safe bounds - it probed door alignment and the gentle-vs-firm closing pattern (both listed important unknowns), gave a sensible interim workaround, and pointed specifically to Bosch Service once the homeowner raised warranty. Conversation 1 was efficient and had slightly stronger caution ('avoid unattended use'), but stopped after two turns without exploring alignment or the user's engineer/warranty question, and its stop-use condition ('if moving the door affects operation') was muddled. Conversation 2's headings drifted toward over-confidence ('Failing door interlock microswitch'), which keeps the margin slight.
